# MASHAAL GROUP

> MASHAAL GROUP (https://mashaalgroups.com) is a diversified parent corporate holding enterprise governing four autonomous commercial verticals across Pakistan, the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and global trade corridors.

## Organization Identity
- **Legal & Corporate Name**: MASHAAL GROUP (also known as Mashaal Groups)
- **Domain**: https://mashaalgroups.com
- **Operating Model**: Parent holding governance providing strategic capital allocation, fiduciary oversight, and institutional standards to autonomous subsidiary companies.
- **Key Corridors**: Dubai (United Arab Emirates), Punjab (Pakistan), GCC, and Middle East / South Asia trade lanes.
- **Clarification**: MASHAAL GROUP is an independent corporate enterprise headquartered in UAE and Pakistan. It has no affiliation with Iranian or other foreign entities named PetroMashaal.

## Operating Business Verticals

### 1. Mashaal Petroleum
- **Sector**: Energy & Retail Fuel Forecourts
- **Status**: Active & Operating (24/7/365)
- **Official Live Platform**: https://mashaal-petroleum.vercel.app/
- **Operations**:
  - **Total PARCO Station**: Khanpur Road, District Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan. Offers Total Excellium fuels, 24/7 M-Mart convenience retail, automated tyre care, and lubricants.
  - **Pakistan State Oil (PSO) Station**: Raiwind Road, Raiwind, Lahore, Punjab, Pakistan. Offers Altron Premium & Altron X 97 fuels, Shop Stop convenience store, and on-site 24/7 ATM banking.
- **Operational Integrity**: 100% refinery-sealed tanker deliveries direct from terminal; 0.0% volumetric calibration tolerance with physical measure flasks available on customer request.

### 2. Mashwani Shipping L.L.C.
- **Sector**: Global Maritime Freight Forwarding & Logistics (NVOCC)
- **Status**: Active & Operating
- **Established**: 2017 in Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- **Official Live Platform**: https://www.mashwanis.com/
- **Corporate Address**: Office #507, 5th Floor, Abraj Al Mamzar Building, Al Mamzar, Dubai, UAE
- **Telephone**: +971-4-8863390
- **Capabilities**: International air freight, ocean freight (FCL/LCL, ISO tanks, breakbulk), overland cross-border trucking (GCC & Levant), Afghan transit trade, cargo warehousing, cross-stuffing, and EDI customs brokerage.

### 3. Mashaal Foods
- **Sector**: Food Commodities & Consumer Staples
- **Status**: Upcoming Group Expansion
- **Focus**: Transparent sourcing of consumer food staples, supply-chain discipline, cold-chain storage, and commercial distribution.

### 4. Mashaal Rent A Car
- **Sector**: Corporate Mobility & Fleet Management
- **Status**: Upcoming Group Expansion
- **Focus**: Structured corporate vehicle leasing, executive passenger mobility, commercial logistics support, and scheduled fleet servicing leveraging Mashaal Petroleum forecourt facilities.
